_readme: BBC Learning English — 6 Minute English (called 5 Minute English until 2014). A catalogue only: the audio, transcripts and worksheets stay on BBC's servers and the app plays from these canonical URLs. No BBC media is stored in this repository or shipped in the APK. Rebuild with tools/fetch_bbc_6min.py --fetch N.
_grading: tools/listening_grade.py — CEFR-J word list (Maximax67/Words-CEFR-Dataset, MIT). A passage's band blends the 75th percentile of its content-word levels, the share of B2+ vocabulary, sentence length and clause density, and speaking rate. Audited against BBC's own level tag with --audit.

episodes.title: BBC Learning English - 6 Minute English
episodes.blurb:
If you’ve got 6 minutes to learn English, listen to 6 Minute English! Improve your listening skills with extracts from BBC radio programmes on many different subjects. We help you to understand, and we also teach you key vocabulary.

If you want something easier, try Real Easy English to hear real conversations in easy English to help you improve your spoken English.
